I'd be happy to help you with LG Smart TV setup instructions. To get started, could you please provide me with the specific model number of your LG Smart TV? This information is usually found on the back of the unit or in the settings menu.

Additionally, could you please describe the issue you're experiencing with setting up your LG Smart TV? For example, are you having trouble connecting to the internet, navigating the menu, or setting up Wi-Fi?

With this information, I can provide you with more specific guidance on how to troubleshoot or set up your LG Smart TV.
